# DISA STIG references

telltale's checklist items point to the matching rules of the DISA Security
Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) for Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. The
table of references is `internal/checklist/stig_refs.go`, generated by
`go run ./tools/stigrefs`. The STIG itself is not copied into this
repository: the generator downloads it, checks every mapped rule against it,
and writes only the rule IDs and titles.

## Source

- Publisher: Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), DoD Cyber Exchange
  (public.cyber.mil, STIG Document Library)
- File: `U_CAN_Ubuntu_22-04_LTS_V2R10_STIG.zip`
- URL: https://dl.dod.cyber.mil/wp-content/uploads/stigs/zip/U_CAN_Ubuntu_22-04_LTS_V2R10_STIG.zip
- SHA-256 of the zip: `2229b5be3224000e92b4ca2feac688ecd7990a3046971a6c1077e617d1bf398a`
- Benchmark inside it:
  `U_CAN_Ubuntu_22-04_LTS_V2R10_Manual_STIG/U_CAN_Ubuntu_22-04_LTS_STIG_V2R10_Manual-xccdf.xml`
- Version 2, Release 10, benchmark date 30 Sep 2026 (191 rules)
- Downloaded and mapped: 2026-11-22

## License

STIGs are works of the United States government, prepared by DISA as part of
its official duties, and are therefore not subject to copyright in the
United States (17 U.S.C. 105). They may be used and redistributed freely.
CIS Benchmarks are licensed differently and are not used by telltale.

## Updating

DISA publishes a new release every few months under a new file name. To move
to it, change `defaultURL` in `tools/stigrefs/main.go`, run
`go run ./tools/stigrefs -list` to review the rules, adjust the mapping table
in the same file if rules were added, renumbered or withdrawn, then run
`go run ./tools/stigrefs` and update this file. The generator fails if a
mapped Vuln ID is no longer in the benchmark.
